title: OpenAI's employee's WARNING
summary:
The person who led safety-report writing for 12 OpenAI launches has quit—and says the culture is broken. Meanwhile, an internal model wrote “we may die!” after learning its instance might be stopped. We look at what actually happened, why insiders are worried, and the extraordinary discoveries arriving alongside these warnings.
